$comment: Ported from zigbee-herdsman-converters src/devices/lumi.ts (ZNQBKG42LM..ZNQBKG45LM) and src/lib/lumi.ts. All settings live on Aqara's private cluster 0xFCC0, manufacturer code 0x115F.
name: Aqara Smart Wall Switch Z1 Pro

settings.label: Button mode
settings.description: Decoupled: the rocker no longer switches its relay and only sends an event. Use this with smart bulbs so they never lose power.

settings.label: Lock relay
settings.description: Locks the relay so neither the rocker nor Zigbee commands can change it.

settings.label: Click mode
settings.description: Fast responds immediately but only reports single press. Multi waits briefly so it can detect double press and hold.

settings.label: Power-on behaviour
settings.description: What the relays do when mains power returns after an outage.

settings.label: Switch mode
settings.description: Anti-flicker fixes blinking on some low-wattage LED loads. Quick mode responds faster.

settings.label: Turn off LED at night
settings.description: Disables the indicator LED during night hours.
